datasource_item.source_question_text:
7. A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed \(v_0\) and an angle \(\theta\) above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. \(v_0\).
B. \(v_0 \cos \theta\).
C. \(v_0 \sin \theta\).
D. 0.
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
Q7. A basketball is launched with speed v0 at an angle θ above the horizontal. What is the ball’s speed at its maximum height (neglect air resistance)?
A. v0.
This ignores that the vertical component of velocity decreases to zero at the top.
B. v0 cos θ.
At maximum height the vertical velocity is zero, so the speed equals the unchanged horizontal component v0 cos θ.
C. v0 sin θ.
This mistakenly takes the initial vertical component as the speed at the top, even though it becomes zero there.
D. 0.
Only the vertical component becomes zero at the top; the horizontal component generally remains nonzero.

4. The raven is sent from the Castle Black, which is at the origin, observing the white walkers at the coordinates \(\vec{r}_4 = 3\hat{i} + 6\hat{j}\) at the beginning of season 4, where length units are in kilofurlongs. Which of the following statements is correct?
A. The distance between the white walkers and the Castle Black is 9 kilofurlongs.
B. The distance between the white walkers and the Castle Black is 6 kilofurlongs.
C. The distance between the white walkers and the Castle Black is 3 kilofurlongs.
D. None of the above is correct.
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
Q4. A scout leaves the old watchtower located at the origin and spots an enemy camp at the coordinates \(\vec{r} = -2\hat{\imath}+7\hat{\jmath}\), where distance is measured in kilofurlongs. Which statement is correct?
A. The distance from the watchtower to the camp is 9 kilofurlongs.
This is the mistaken sum of the magnitudes of components (2 + 7) rather than the vector magnitude.
B. The distance from the watchtower to the camp is 7 kilofurlongs.
This incorrectly uses only the y-component as the full distance.
C. The distance from the watchtower to the camp is 2 kilofurlongs.
This incorrectly uses only the x-component’s magnitude as the full distance.
D. None of the above is correct.
The distance is \(\sqrt{(-2)^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{53} \approx 7.3\) kilofurlongs, which is not listed in A–C.
